description: This file defines an Android activity class 'DetailActivity' which displays details of a tourist attraction. It contains methods for launching the activity with or without transition animations, retrieving intent data, and setting up the activity's UI components.

classes.name: DetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that shows detailed information about a tourist attraction, also supporting shared element transitions.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Static method to start the DetailActivity with optional shared element transition animation.

methods.name: getLaunchIntent
methods.description: Static method to generate an intent for launching DetailActivity with attraction data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the layout, and adds the DetailFragment if not restoring a previous state.
